commitments.detail: Used oil drums will be disposed of on 2023-10-15.
Batteries will be palletized and labeled for pickup on 2023-10-17.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned on 2023-10-18.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up on 2023-10-17 without an upright rack.
Used oil drums will be picked up on 2023-10-15.
Vehicle batteries require palletizing and labeling before pickup on 2023-10-17.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned on 2023-10-18.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up on 2023-10-17 without an upright rack.
Used oil drums will be disposed of.
Vehicle batteries will be palletized and labeled if necessary.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up and transported upright.
Used oil drums will be disposed of at the local waste management facility.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned to the base supply chain for reuse.
Vehicle batteries and empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up by an external contractor on the specified dates.
